capabilities: Upload pasted or dragged images to image hosting services
Upload arbitrary files to a public GitHub repository
Embed uploaded files as Markdown image or link syntax
Switch between multiple hosting providers in the settings
Delete Imgur anonymous uploads via the returned deletehash
extras: Warns that files uploaded to GitHub and the image hosts are public and must comply with each service's terms; notes abuse of GitHub or jsDelivr quotas can affect the account; large or unsupported uploads may produce a broken ![](undefined) link; accepts donations ('buying me a cola').
intentEvidence: If you find that Cloudinary is enough to meet your needs, you can just use it.
problem: Obsidian stores pasted images and files as local vault attachments, which cannot be rendered or shared when notes are published or viewed elsewhere.

relations.evidence: If you find that Cloudinary is enough to meet your needs, you can just use it.

requires.name: hosting platform account (GitHub, Imgur, SM.MS, Catbox, etc.)

summary: Uploader that sends pasted or dragged images to hosting services like Imgur, SM.MS and GitHub, or files to GitHub, and embeds the returned links in Markdown.
